snippet.title: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
Metroid Prime 4: Beyond releases for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on Dec 4, 2025. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/metroid-prime-4-beyond-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Samus is targeted by the deadly sharpshooter Sylux, and lands on Viewros in the aftermath of their clash. She’ll need all her tools and abilities, including her new technologically-advanced bike Vi-O-La, to survive and escape.
 
Additionally, three new Metroid Prime 4: Beyond amiibo are also on the way: Samus (Metroid Prime 4), Samus & Vi-O-La (Metroid Prime 4), and enigmatic bounty hunter Sylux (Metroid Prime 4). 

#MetroidPrime4 #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect
